Question 20
?

Find the equation of the left-opening parabola that has its vertex at (4,−3) and passes through the point (1,0).

a
(y−4)2=−3(x+3)
b
(y+3)2=−2(x−4)
c
(y+3)2=3(x−4)
d
(y+3)2=−3(x−4)
e
(y+3)2=2(x−4)
